title: ReadPosition bidirectional note re-states federation Receiver Behavior
description: The bidirectional opt-out note at the end of the ReadPosition section (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md ~line 763) states a normative MUST NOT: 'when PresenceStatus.receiptSharing is false, the server MUST NOT deliver inbound Peer/receipt events (carrying readAt) to the owner's clients.' The same normative requirement is stated more precisely in the Peer/receipt Receiver Behavior section of draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md (~lines 313-315), which also adds that deliveredAt MAY still be recorded. The ReadPosition note is a forward-reference summary that introduces a second normative location for the same rule, creating a maintenance burden and potential for divergence. Suggested improvement: replace the MUST NOT in the ReadPosition note with a purely informative cross-reference, e.g. 'The receipt-sharing opt-out is bidirectional: an account that does not broadcast its own read times will also not receive others' read times; see Peer/receipt Receiver Behavior in {{JMAP-CHAT-FED}} for normative requirements.'
close_reason: Resolved by wrl.9 fix: ReadPosition note now references JMAP-CHAT-FED rather than restating the rule
